articleTitle: Assessment of Conflict Structure Recognition and Bias Impact in Japanese LLMs
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In recent years, with the evolution and proliferation of large language models (LLMs), their application in various fields, including security, has been expanding. LLMs, which learn from vast amounts of text data and possess the capability to process diverse information, may incorporate biases during the learning process. This necessitates cautious consideration when using LLMs in the realm of security. This study examines the perceptions and biases that Japanese LLMs hold towards global conflict structures, including the warring nations of Ukraine and Russia. We conducted experiments based on a novel method and evaluation metric utilizing sentiment analysis on tweet data. The results revealed that while LLMs have some understanding of conflict structures, they tend to exhibit a positive bias towards specific countries in relationships where the conflict structure is unclear. Furthermore, continual pre-training with Japanese text data showed a tendency to intensify certain biases. These findings highlight the risks associated with using LLMs in the security sector and propose the creation of bias-aware datasets and suggestions for enhancing robustness to ensure fairness towards nations.

articleTitle: Classification Framework for Autoimmune Liver Disease using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Autoimmune diseases affect people of all ages, genders, and ethnic backgrounds, making it one of the most widespread health issues we face today. These disorders occur when the immune system mistakenly targets healthy cells within the body and causing a wide range of potentially life-threatening diseases. There are over 80 recognized autoimmune disorders, including type-1 diabetes, rheumatoid arthritis, Graves’ disease, alopecia, celiac disease, and autoimmune liver disease(AiLD). Autoimmune liver disease is one such chronic disorder characterized by liver inflammation and damage. If not detected on time and untreated within the given time, it might lead to liver cirrhosis or liver cancer. Identifying and treating autoimmune liver disease is a complex and time consuming process which involves symptom analysis, laboratory tests, and clinical assessments. Detecting the disease can be more challenging because many symptoms of autoimmune liver diseases overlap with those of other autoimmune conditions. As a result, there is a need for an optimized, accurate, efficient, and cost-effective methodology to identify the disease without extensive and invasive procedures such as organ transplants. This paper introduces an innovative approach that employs the power of supervised machine learning and deep learning techniques to predict the onset of autoimmune liver diseases in advance. The machine learning model is constructed using a comprehensive dataset comprising the complete medical history of patients, physical examination records, histopathology and genetic data. Along with the machine learning model, the deep learning model is also developed for liver MRI images of various patients to make accurate prediction. This system provides a second opinion for medical professionals that may avoid the need for extensive and invasive medical procedures, including biopsies, and ultimately improve patient care and outcomes.

articleTitle: Optimal Operation of Microgrid Through Loss-Guided Neural Network-Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The uncertainty in microgrid systems introduces significant difficulties in their operation, such as increasing the operational costs when using conventional optimization algorithms. In this study, a Deep Neural Network (DNN)-based optimization model is proposed to minimize the operation costs of a microgrid system. The input layer of the DNN captures comprehensive system information, which is processed through hidden layers. The output layer provides optimal set-points for controllable distributed generation units, aiming to minimize operational costs while fulfilling operational constraints. A customized loss function has been developed to guide the DNN's training process without the need for any labels or datasets. Moreover, the uncertainties of demand and market price signals are considered during the training process to manage the system dynamics in real-time operations of the microgrid. Unlike the conventional backpropagation approach, this study employs Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) to update the DNN's parameters, ensuring faster convergence and a more stable training process. Finally, the efficacy of the proposed method is verified under conditions both with and without system uncertainty.

articleTitle: AI-Driven Recommendations for Digital Majors Based on Learning Styles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In response to industry demands, universities offer diverse digital technology majors, some focusing purely on technology while others integrate with domains like arts, business, or science. These interdisciplinary programs aim to equip students with the skills necessary to thrive in a digitally driven world. However, matching students with the right major can be challenging, especially given the diverse learning preferences among students. The VARK framework categorizes students into visual, aural, reading/writing, and kinesthetic learners, while the Kolb model classifies learners based on their experiences as diverger, assimilators, converger, or accommodators. These frameworks offer insights into how students prefer to acquire and retain information. The resulting predictive models will recommend the most suitable majors for students based on their learning styles. These recommendations will consider the compatibility between students' preferred learning methods with digital major. Moreover, leveraging machine learning models can predict students' suitability for digital majors based on learning styles. Analyzing student profiles and outcomes facilitates informed decisions, benefiting both students and universities in shaping educational pathways and career trajectories. Through the application of Support Vector Classifier, this study seeks to provide personalized academic guidance to students, helping them make informed decisions about their educational pathways. By considering students' individual learning styles, universities can enhance the effectiveness of their digital maj or offerings, ultimately addressing the shortage of skilled digital professionals in the workforce. The study findings showcase the proposed approach as highly promising, achieving outstanding classification accuracy. Specifically, the Area Under the Curve (AUC) accuracy values are notable: Animation and Visual Effects with an AUC of 0.89, Business Computer with an AUC of 0.97, and Computer Engineering with an AUC of 0.96.

articleTitle: The Role of Technology in Financial Management: A Study on Economic Value Added
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Financial technology supports company performance, but it cannot be separated from the risks it will face. Good financial management is needed to support company performance by measuring stock returns. The aim of this research is to analyze the implementation of financial technology through economic value added to stock returns which is mediated by business risk. The research method used is a quantitative type by taking data on companies indexed LQ45 for the period 2018 to 2022. Data collection was done through purposive sampling, there were 22 companies out of 45 companies indexed LQ45 on the Indonesia Stock Exchange (IDX). Data were analyzed using a path analysis approach with STATA statistical tools. The research results found that economic value added had an influence on increasing stock returns. This means that efficiency through the implementation of financial technology supports the achievement of company stock returns. Another finding stated that business risk has an influence on stock returns. Furthermore, it was stated that economic value added has a negative effect on business risk. The research findings explain that business risk is not appropriate as a mediator between economic value added in supporting an increase in company returns. Companies are deemed to need to pay attention to business risks, especially technological factors. Considering the importance of financial technology in supporting increased economic value added through efficiency. Technology support for company management is an important part of supporting stock returns.

articleTitle: A Low-Code Platform of Carbon Credit Trading Using Blockchain Technology: A Case Study in Nakhon Si Thammarat Province
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Carbon credit is one of the measures within the Emission Trading Scheme (ETS), which serves as a mechanism to offset the amount of greenhouse gases one emits beyond the allocated rights to emit greenhouse gases. Although there are the existed carbon credit trading platforms, this research aimed to study a carbon credit trading prototype platform by using a low code with blockchain technology (BT). The rubber tree data at Nakhon Si Thammarat province in 3 age groups; namely 6-, 14-, and 22-year-old tree were used as the initial input data along with the area size of rubber tree field. After simulating the developed platform, the results show that the carbon content of the projects that have already been purchased can be sold or re-purchased while the contract for the transaction is recorded on the blockchain. Furthermore, the developed low code platform can save the platform's cost and the developing time, moreover, people without IT experience can use this low-code model to develop platforms of interest.

articleTitle: The Development of Digital Marketing Platform to Promote the Sustainable Local Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research focuses on the development of digital marketing platform “ruamkhai” aimed at promoting a sustainable local economy. By analyzing the needs of the people and designing a suitable platform for selling community products. The study covered 5 provinces: Maha Sarakham, Nakhon Sawan, Khon Kaen, Chiang Mai, and Bangkok. With a total population of 671 people, data collection tools were focus group, in-depth interviews and survey. Data were analyzed using content analysis, pattern matching and a preliminary study (Exploratory Study). The results of the research found four main problems: security, product standards, transaction data, and online business skills. The research used the Community Business Model (CBMC) to analyze the business model. The ruamkhai platform has a total of 584 users. Most of the best-selling products are in the food/beverage category. ROI analysis reveals that sellers' revenue increased by more than 10%. Research shows that “ruamkhai” platforms can help increase income and boost the local economy. In addition, the integration with other platforms such as “ruamrean” and “ruamshare” through API creates a new ecosystem in Thailand. Lead to sustainable development in every province across the country and support strategic planning of the province and country.

articleTitle: Data Maturity Model and Goal-Oriented Approach to Elicit Business Requirements
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: During the age of data abundance, organisations tend to realise the significance of leveraging the use of data to drive their strategic decisions and obtain competitive advantages. However, many organisations might lack awareness of their full potential to expand their data utilisation to align with their business goals. Moreover, some organisations may realise the value of data but are unable to articulate their business requirements regarding data utilisation practices in detail. As such, this paper proposes the combination of data maturity models and the goal-oriented requirements engineering approach to assist these organisations in understanding their data maturity levels as well as discover areas of improvements to elicit their business requirements which also align with their business goals. To address this challenge, the web-based tool for assessing data maturity level with the goal-oriented approach was developed and used in a small IT consulting company as a case study. The result showed that by using the data maturity model combined with the goal-oriented requirements engineering approach, the company can reduce the time to elicit business requirements from their customers. Besides, the case study company can also offer a roadmap to leverage the use of data which aligns with the business goals of their customers.

articleTitle: A Novel Guideline Framework for Research and Development in the Field of Management of Technology and Innovation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper presents a novel framework for creating and developing research in the field of management of technology and innovation which is a new guideline for developing research in this field. It starts with designing a concept and developing a new conceptual model. After that, such a new conceptual model is developed to further lead to the creation of a new conceptual framework, and finally, the implement by handling technology is put into practice to become concrete according to the new concept. The results can be shown by evidence from many papers published in high-level international journals. Consequently, these findings can provide a springboard and foundation for further research by allowing for the examination and development of novel concepts.

articleTitle: Digital Arts: An Innovation for Intangible Cultural Heritage
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Rapid societal change threatens Intangible Cultural Heritage (ICH), a vital connector across generations. This paper explores Digital Arts as a strategic innovation to revitalize ICH. By leveraging digital tools, engaging experiences can transmit cultural heritage to new audiences. Participatory design ensures these experiences resonate with all ages. By combining Digital Arts, participatory design, and action research, we can develop innovative strategies to revitalize ICH, strengthening social cohesion and cultural identity.

articleTitle: Rice Commodity Supply Chain Issues in Indonesia: Exploring Blockchain Technology as an Alternative Solution
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Agriculture has long been recognized as pivotal to economic development, offering avenues to alleviate poverty, foster prosperity, and sustainably meet the food demands of a burgeoning global population projected to reach 9.7 billion by 2050. However, persistent inefficiencies within agricultural supply chains, particularly in sectors like rice production, pose formidable challenges. Addressing these inefficiencies is imperative to avert a surge in hunger and malnutrition. Failure to do so could condemn 815 million people to hunger and leave 3 out of 10 individuals malnourished. Thus, investigating solutions to enhance the resilience of rice supply chains is paramount. This research endeavors to identify and analyze challenges inherent in tracing the rice supply chain, offering a conceptual model proposal as a potential remedy. Employing a methodology centered on scholarly discourse and extensive literature review, our study reveals various impediments facing rice commodity supply chains in Indonesia. Furthermore, this study leverages blockchain technology, specifically the Sawtooth Hyperledger platform, to streamline the tracing process for rice commodities and rationalize the supply chain by reducing intermediary actors. From the proposed model, there is great hope that it can provide implications for the rice supply chain to run more efficiently.

articleTitle: The Current State of Generative AI Prompt Framework Design for Enhancing Utility in Organizational Decision-Making
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel framework that combines deep learning algorithms with reinforcement learning techniques to optimize decision-making processes in dynamic and complex environments. The framework aims to improve the accuracy, efficiency, and adaptability of AI systems in supporting strategic decision-making for organizations across various industries. Key features of generative AI prompt frameworks include the development of prompt engineering techniques, addressing technological challenges, and applying prompt engineering across various domains like entrepreneurship, art, and science. The AI PROMPT framework provides guidelines for text-to-text prompt engineering. This paper provides prompt engineering techniques and indicators to improve the overall quality and effectiveness of utility in organizational decision-making.

articleTitle: Design of a Sustainable Container-Based Aquaponics System for Tropical Climate
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Food security is a rising threat caused by the increase in global population and the gradual reduction in land for traditional agriculture. Container farms are gaining popularity due to their reduced reliance on traditional soil-based agriculture while being an innovative agricultural practice in cities. An extensive review was conducted to identify and evaluate the design features of container farms worldwide. As the design features are not completely suitable for tropical regions, this paper, therefore, aims to design a modular, scalable, and high-performance container-based aquaponics system that allows for all-year-round production of crops in a tropical climate. The proposed passive design features and green infrastructure include frames, floors, walls, ventilation, doors, and a mechanical and electrical room. Using semi-transparent building-integrated photovoltaic (BIPV) technology, simulations and analyzes of incident radiation on BIPV solar panels and grow towers were also conducted to ascertain the most effective panel setup for the container-based aquaponics system. Beneath the BIPV solar panels lies an innovative multi-loop aquaponics system that can efficiently cultivate fish and vegetables concurrently, addressing food security concerns.

articleTitle: Digital Platform for Coach, Resource Person and Activity Planner Job
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a CRA digital platform for society. The platform is used as a medium on business ecosystem for two groups of people. The first group is producer or service providers, including coaches, resource person and activity planner job. The second group, consumers, are members of the general public which can use the platform to search for coaches, resource person and activity planner. The system architecture consists of back-end system and front-end system. The system has subsystem such as platform user registration system, user management system, schedule booking system, profile management system, article management system and work schedule management system. The system is web application running on Microsoft Windows operation system. The system was automated testing using the Selenium IDE program with various test cases for 3 groups of users: user, coach and admin. It appears that the system can function properly according to the designed function in all respects.

articleTitle: Unleashing Enjoyment, Engagement, and Motivation to Boost Green Gamified Banking Investigating the Cognitive Role in Green Green-Gamified Banking
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Different strategies have been employed by marketers over recent years to create environmental awareness. Gamification is one of them. These gamifications evolve into positive emotions and can convey messages, leading to sustainable behavior. However, the use of such gamification in e-banking is yet to be explored. This study explores a new paradigm “green gamified banking” through e-banking users. The following study develops a hypothesis on three primary emotions, enjoyment, engagement, and motivation, side by side, to provide sufficient evidence of gamification used in e-business such as e-banking. We provided a game algorithm to support the theory and developed a variable. For a feasibility check, we first found e-banking customers who were part of such games and were interested in sharing their experiences. In this context, a survey of 264 people was conducted. We performed partial least square-structural equation modeling, and the results suggested serious games in e-banking. Besides a sustainable agenda, it contains an element of positive emotions that enable users to be part of such a cause. The empirical analysis provides evidence enjoyment and motivation have positively significant partial mediation, whereas engagement remained insignificant.

articleTitle: Predictions of Undesirable Behaviors While Driving Part 2
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The driving behavior of the driver is a major factor that can determine to what extent road accidents may occur. One of the behaviors that contributes to accidents is distracted driving and fatigue while driving, which divert attention away from driving. This has prompted many researchers to attempt to find methods of detecting these behaviors in order to reduce road accidents stemming from these causes. One of the detection methods that many researchers are interested in is using pressure sensors installed on seats and headrests. This detection method is convenient to implement as it does not require installation of any sensors on the driver. This paper is a continuation researcher study that reducing the usage of pressure sensors from the previous study [1], which reduce utilization of 9 sensor positions, down to 6 while maintaining high detection and classification accuracies. Analysis methods, including statistical data analysis, SelectKBest, and Recursive Feature Elimination (RFE) with 3 Machine Learning (ML) models. They then assessed which sensor positions had the highest importance scores, selecting the top 6 positions for further evaluation with Machine Learning to determine how much their performance differed from the original. The analysis revealed that when using only the selected 6 positions, referred to as 6 features, for training and testing with the Decision Tree model, the performance reduced by only 0.0197 percent.

articleTitle: Development of Low-Code Platform for Electrical Power Trading Using Blockchain and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Despite the government's encouragement of individuals to install on-grid solar panels in order to sell electricity as producers, the government still has authority over the purchasing and selling prices. For a new paradigm known as peer-to-peer (P2P) electrical energy trading, the objective of this study is to develop a low-code platform for P2P electricity auctions trading, where sellers and buyers can free to desire their prices. The blockchain technology (BT) is merged into the platform along with the artificial intelligence technology (AI) to lift up the system security and automatically determine the optimal bidding prices, respectively. The research utilized data from 20-house electricity trading auctions to train the AI model and assist in determining the most suitable electricity trading prices in the auctions. The results show that the developed platform can match the buyers and sellers who win auctions during the automated trading period obtain the best prices for electricity trading. The low-code platform significantly decreases the developing time while the BT with AI can provide the exchanged and recorded transaction data. They also enhance the security of the trading information and contributed to a higher level of security in the transactions. This research also provided insights for future development of artificial intelligence using low-code platforms, with the goal of applying it in the future.

articleTitle: Ruamrean: Transformative Developments in Learning Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In the context of rapidly evolving digital technologies, existing learning management systems (LMS) often reveal significant shortcomings, particularly in their capacity to integrate seamlessly within the diverse and dynamic ecosystems of contemporary educational environments. To address these challenges, the “Ruamrean” platform was developed, aiming to foster a comprehensive ‘Learning City’ that supports lifelong learning and cultivates a robust learning ecosystem. This research advances the development of a resilient database platform system designed to enhance interagency collaboration among municipal education bodies and augment the quality of life within communities through educational innovations. Implemented across five provinces and engaging 1,030 participants, the methodology employed includes both focus group interviews and in-depth interviews, with data analysis executed via content analysis and exploratory studies. The results demonstrate that the “Ruamrean” platform effectively accommodates various user groups-learners, instructors, and system administrators-offering an extensive catalogue of courses, predominantly in technology-related areas. The development of this platform represents a pivotal advancement in overcoming the educational constraints observed in existing systems and significantly contributes to the sustainable development of local communities.

articleTitle: The Technical Aesthetics and Spectacular Narratives of Science Fiction Films in the Perspective of Digital Media
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Digital technology has always influenced the image aesthetics and film narrative of movies, allowing movies to present diverse features and unique expression forms. At present, digital media technology is developing rapidly, and its impact on movies is increasingly significant. This article starts from the perspective of digital media, takes science fiction movies as the research object, and combines the historical practice of world science fiction movies to analyze the technical aesthetics of science fiction movies generated by digital technology. By exploring the technical aesthetics of science fiction movies, this paper specifically analyzes their unique technical composition, aesthetic characteristics and spectacle narratives in order to gain insight into the aesthetic characteristics and new narrative changes of science fiction movies in the current era.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cyberbullying Detection on Social Media Using Transformer Models
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The proliferation of cyberbullying on social media platforms has led to devastating physical, emotional, and mental consequences for victims, underscoring the need for effective identification and analysis methods. This study leverages Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, specifically Transformer models, to enhance cyberbullying detection in harmful social media messages. By employing transfer learning and fine-tuning strategies, we compared the effectiveness of category prediction using five prominent Transformer models: BERT, RoBERTa, ALBERT, DistilBERT, and ConvBERT. Our results demonstrate that DistilBERT outperforms other models, achieving an accuracy of 94.36%, precision of 93.83%, and recall of 93.91% in the 5-Class categorization of cyberbullying severity. This study highlights the significance of automated cyberbullying detection and underscores the potential of NLP techniques in combating the adverse impacts of cyberbullying. The findings of this research have important implications for the development of effective cyberbullying detection systems, which can help mitigate the harmful effects of online harassment. By leveraging the capabilities of DistilBERT, we can create more accurate and efficient systems for detecting and preventing cyberbullying, ultimately contributing to a safer online environment.

articleTitle: Key knowledge extraction and learning from experience of online Chinese Key Opinion Leaders
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The objective of this article is to collect and summarize key knowledge about the short video content creation of KOLs located on social media platforms. Key knowledge in this study means KOLs' key knowledge in video production. The study selected five Top-KOLs and extracted their core knowledge from the KOL followers' feedback and suggestions. After that, the study combined the key knowledge obtained from the five KOLs and created new video content presented on the social media platform. Learning occurs from the experience of creating content. The results of this study include main knowledge from content creation experiences and key knowledge from the top 5 KOLs which are content creation planning, video shooting, and video clip, respectively.

articleTitle: Overnight Charging Mechanism of Battery Electric Buses for a Transit Network in Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Battery electric buses (BEBs) are known for being eco-friendly transportation in smart cities. They are cost-effective compared to their diesel counterpart if BEBs are charged ef-ficiently. There are two main charging approaches for BEBs, namely, off-service (overnight) and on-route (opportunity) charging. The overnight electricity rate is typically lower than the daytime rate. Consequently, overnight charging is considered the most affordable approach to meet the daily energy needs of the electrified transit network. This paper introduces a new intelligent overnight charging mechanism-i.e, Priority Charging Mechanism (PCM)-that charges BEBs simultaneously using the optimum number of chargers to minimize infrastructure costs. The model is evaluated using the actual transit network data of the city of Thunder Bay.

articleTitle: Determination of Pure Animal Fat Concentrations and Halal Category from Mixed Animal Fats Raman Spectra
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Analysis of chemical and biological compounds generally uses the Raman spectrum because of its non-destructive nature. Raman spectra can be analyzed computationally using chemometric methods. The principal component analysis (PCA) method can be combined with another regression or classification model to determine the concentrations of fat and halal categories from animal fats data. This research aims to determine the best regression methods for finding pure spectrum concentrations in mixed spectra of animal fats based on the lowest root mean square error (RMSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) of the regressor, and to determine the best classifier methods for finding halal categories of animal fats. It is shown that the PCA with decision tree regressor performs better on training data than random forest or K-nearest neighbor to predict pure animal fats concentrations, with mean squared error (MSE) of 0.001 and MAE of 0.002 on training data. The decision tree classifier also performs better than the random forest or K-nearest neighbor classifier in predicting the halal category, with 0.94 recall in the haram class and 0.90 recall in the halal class. However, this model still does not meet the conditions to have 1 recall value in the haram class as expected for real-world applications.

articleTitle: The Visualization Design of Performance Management Tracking: A Case Study of Retailing Telecommunication Business
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research focuses on designing and implementing a performance tracking system for the retail business line of a telecommunication company, addressing the complexity and user-unfriendly nature of existing data sources. The study aimed to develop a comprehensive system for accessing crucial performance data, design a user-friendly performance display system, and implement a tool to assist users in planning their work effectively. Data from 242 branches and 1400 employees were collected, cleaned, transformed, and visualized using SQL and HTML. A satisfaction survey among 716 employees revealed a high level of satisfaction, with an average score of 4.40 out of 5, indicating that the dashboard significantly enhanced data accessibility and usability. The findings demonstrate that the dashboard effectively simplifies complex performance data, supports informed decision-making, and improves operational efficiency, providing valuable insights for future system design and development in similar business contexts.

articleTitle: Applying YOLO Model in iCAR for Multi-Detection: Object Detection and Hand Gesture Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Computer vision technology is increasingly pivotal across various industries, particularly in transportation, where it plays a critical role in enhancing both efficiency and safety, especially in autonomous vehicles. This study addresses a significant challenge encountered by autonomous cars, exemplified by iCAR's inability to identify and provide access to traffic officers. The project's objective is to equip iCAR with the capability to recognize traffic officers and enable hand gesture-based access control. By leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) integrated with the You Only Look Once (YOLO V8) model, a robust model was developed and trained on a dataset comprising approximately 5000 images that include traffic officers and hand gestures. The study yielded promising results, as indicated by the F1 score analysis, with an average F1 score across all classes reaching 0.96, underscoring the model's effectiveness. Through the integration of computer vision technology, iCAR facilitates seamless human-vehicle interaction by accurately discerning traffic officers and granting them access via hand gestures.

articleTitle: Heat Press Pineapple Leaf Machine for Small and Medium Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The Heat Press Pineapple Leaf Machine for small and medium (SMEs) Businesses is an innovation developed to simplify the dried leaf preparation process and improve the productivity of pineapple leaf product. The design model of Design Thinking was used for this study which consists of the phases of empathy, definition, ideas, prototype, and testing. The innovation was brought to creative ideas into existence. The objective of this study was to design, develop and test to improve process by the creation of a Pineapple leaf press Machine. Based on evaluation from experts, it was found that they agree with the prototype of pineapple leaf dried press Machine for communities' clothes and apparel in terms of design, function, and suitability. Besides, the Pineapple leaf dried press Machine gives out leaves dried condition that the consumers need and there is accuracy in dried press time, the standards time is able to be determined and the process productivity is improved.

articleTitle: Development of Bio-Conversion Device of Market Wastes into Methane Gas with Solar-Powered Monitoring System using Microcontroller at Tanauan City, Batangas
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: One of the primary issues affecting the Philippines is the management and disposal of solid waste. Public marketplaces have been highlighted as one of the significant causes of garbage generation. The market waste that appears to be a problem may also be used to create a renewable supply. Rather than allowing garbage to fester in landfills, it is more effective and efficient to use and convert them to biogas. This study aimed to solve this challenge as a way forward by employing these market wastes to create clean fuels and utilizing automation of the Arduino monitoring system for better usage. Various sensors will be installed on the biogas digester tank to monitor the temperature, pH, and pressure all of which influence the rate of gas production, while the sensor installed on the storage tank will detect the gas level of the tank, then the information gathered by the sensors will be displayed via LCD. To analyze and compare methods, the researchers utilized a heating element to warm the substrates directly inside the biodigester periodically. The heating element altered the temperature by transferring heat to the slurry. This scenario implied that higher temperatures triggered chemical reactions that led to heightened pH levels and increased production of methane gas. The data clearly presented the advantage of controlled temperature when producing methane gas. Using a heating element to maintain a specific temperature significantly affected the days it took to produce methane from market wastes.

articleTitle: A Multithreaded Approach to Masking Images used for Animation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The current research is focused on designing a multithreaded parallel solution for processing a pair of raster image files that are used to create an animation. In the computational process, a multithreaded model was used when processing arrays of data. The proposed approach is verified by a multithreaded parallel program implementation. The effectiveness of the proposed solution has been verified experimentally by processing an image with dimensions 4320x5400 and a white color mask. The obtained results in terms of execution time show an acceleration of the computational process when increasing the number of threads.

articleTitle: Health Data Management System for Vulnerable Groups in Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The rapid increase of specialized care among elderly and disabled populations has highlighted the limitations of traditional health data management methods. This study introduces a web-based health data management system designed to streamline the collection, storage, and retrieval of health information for vulnerable groups within communities. The system aims to provide easy access to necessary health services, reduce administrative burdens, and enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of health care delivery. Designed as a web application, it is accessible via any device with a web browser, with data stored on a Virtual Private Server (VPS) for real-time access and easy management. Key features include recording personal and health information, tracking assistance history, and managing training records and social rights. The system was tested in Ban Thi Subdistrict, Lamphun Province, demonstrating significant reductions in redundant healthcare costs and empowering caregivers with tools to efficiently manage the care of vulnerable individuals, thereby aligning with national policies to enhance the quality of life for all community members.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Detection of the Optic Disc and Exudates in Color Retinal Images
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The presence of Exudates (EX) is one of the earliest clinical symptoms of Diabetic Retinopathy (DR). Early detection and accurate segmentation of these lesions are crucial for diagnosing and treating DR. However, automatic detection of EX is challenging due to its wide range of shapes, sizes, and brightness levels, which can easily be confused with other lesions. In this paper, a novel method has been proposed for detecting EX in retinal images. The proposed method is based on a three-stage approach that includes pre-processing images, automatic coarse segmentation using a color histogram extraction, and refining inaccurately segmented EX using a mathematical morphology dilatation if the obtained coarse segmentation is suboptimal. The proposed method is evaluated on six publicly available datasets (2,067 images). The evaluation results demonstrated that the proposed method with LUV color space achieved an average sensitivity of 0.942%, specificity of 0.940%, and accuracy of 0.941 %. The proposed method can also diagnose EX in <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\sim 6$</tex> seconds per image.

articleTitle: The Customer Requirements About Thai SMEs Product Based on Customer Knowledge Management by Using Text Mining
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In the context of the close relationship and frequent trade between China and Thailand, this study focuses on the problem that Thai SMEs have insufficient data on Chinese customers and the Chinese market. SMEs are not only smaller than large enterprises, chain enterprises and multinational enterprises in scale, but also have limited resources, capital and knowledge and numerous competitors. To avoid unnecessary cost losses, SMEs should learn to acquire knowledge and analyze the market from customers. This study helps Thai SMEs understand the current Chinese customers and the Chinese market so that entrepreneurs can target their products to customers and enhance their competitiveness. The researcher adopts methods of text mining, extracting product comments directly on Chinese social networking and shopping platforms, to obtain the popular trends and customer needs in China nowadays. By capturing keywords from the website, the high-frequency words mentioned by Chinese consumers about products are analyzed. Then, the top 5 positive words and negative words mentioned are obtained respectively, to realize the objective of understanding the needs of Chinese customers.

articleTitle: Important Information Structuring of International Program Using Ontology to Design Knowledge Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper focuses on the issue of information and knowledge management for master students in Chinese universities. According to some foreign learners' statements, the information from official channels is fragmented and the user experience is not good. After reviewing related websites, the researcher then selected two foreign universities as the best practices and identified and analyzed information from their official information distribution channels by keyword-oriented identification and constructing ontologies. As a part of result, this paper also attempts to solve this problem by designing a knowledge management system according to ontologies and information identification. This knowledge management system gathered almost all published information and provided it to users to boost their experience during study in China.

articleTitle: Integrating Robotic Process Automation (RPA) with Hybrid Cloud Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research aims to 1) apply an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system with cloud computing, 2) implement automated workflow processes (RPA) using UiPath tools within the ERP production cycle, and 3) assess the efficiency of automated workflow processes (RPA) within the ERP production cycle on cloud computing platforms. The results from applying automated workflow processes (RPA with UiPath) within the production cycle of the enterprise resource planning system (ERP with Odoo) hosted on cloud servers (Cloud with Microsoft Azure) indicate that manual processes in the production formula system take 1.05 times longer than automated processes, manual processes in the purchasing system take 1.29 times longer, manual processes in the goods receipt system take 1.22 times longer, and manual processes in the production operations take 1.15 times longer than their automated counterparts.

articleTitle: Assessing Self-Efficacy Method for Enhancing Computational Thinking in Educational Game Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Self-efficacy is critical for improving computational thinking in gaming. However, conventional assessment methods like questionnaires can produce disengaged responses or require additional work to understand the questions and have limitations in the assessment of dynamic self-efficacy. To address this challenge, this study proposes a method using in-game features to assess self-efficacy, which can change over the playtime. The employed in-game feature is the Planning Stage, in which learners strategize and prepare their approach before engaging with challenges. We collect data on the time spent in this stage, which is newly proposed in this study. The experiment was conducted with twenty-five students in the Multimedia Technology and Animation Major playing Tenacity-P to accomplish tasks from a computer programming course. To validate the method, we compared self-efficacy results from the game-based approach with those from conventional questionnaires. The findings highlight the need for strategic planning in managing difficult tasks. As challenges increased, performance measures varied more, underscoring the importance of strong problem-solving skills. Efficient strategic planning directly improved self-efficacy, as participants with better planning skills maintained higher self-efficacy despite increasing task difficulty.

articleTitle: Fake News Detection Using Multi Modal Deep Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Social media is in wide usage among different sections of society. It helps them to connect with each other and can also be used as a medium to spread fake news. Such misinformation can be very dangerous as it can misguide youth and other age groups to take adverse steps leading to violence and other crimes. Hence efforts are needed to classify social media news as fake or real. Earlier lot of efforts have been made to classify news articles from their text by creating natural language processing deep learning models. Since, these days social media depends a lot on images hence it is needed that both text and associated images must be analyzed to know the fakeness of a news article. Thus multimodal deep learning models have been introduced which can extract features from both images and associated text and then fuse these features to pass to a classification output layer. Using this approach it was found that classification with both data as input an accuracy of 74.4 % was obtained on a publicly available dataset.

articleTitle: Enhancing Student Learning Achievement in Basic Agriculture Education and Smart Technology Through Cross-Peer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Peer learning is an effective approach that enhances student learning in various academic fields. However, little is known about how peer learning specifically improves student achievement in basic agricultural education and smart technology. This research used a pretest-posttest design to examine the impact of cross-peer learning on student learning achievement in these subjects. The study involved two groups of students, 17 from Darunsikkhalai School for Innovative Learning (DSIL) and 23 from Mechai Bamboo School (MBS), selected by convenience sampling. For one week, MBS students tutored DSIL students in basic agriculture, while DSIL students tutored MBS students in smart technology. Data were collected before and after the intervention for both groups. The results of the Wilcoxon Signed Rank Test showed significant improvements in the learning achievements of both groups. This study adds to the existing body of knowledge by highlighting the important role of peer learning in enhancing students' content knowledge in basic agricultural education and smart technology.

articleTitle: A Case Study of Implementation of Digitalization into Digital Transformation in Clean Energy Hybrid Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This Paper focused on examining the utilization of digital system architecture in clean energy hybrid power plants, as well as the implementation of digital technology in such power plants. The paper examines three clean energy power plants in the southern area that are now undergoing a transition to Clean Energy Hybrid Power Plant. It is a case study focused on these specific power plants. The data was gathered through interviews with key informants, who were the leaders or executives of the clean hybrid energy generating plant. The paper, however, employed a purposive sample approach to specifically pick the main informants. A comprehensive and organized interview was conducted to collect data to gain a deeper understanding of the transition to a clean hybrid power plant. The information obtained from the interview was organized and classified using the analytic induction technique.

articleTitle: Micro-Credentials : Educator's Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Micro-credentials have emerged as a promising avenue for educators to enhance their professional development and acquire specialized skills in a rapidly evolving educational landscape. This research focuses on educators' perspectives on micro-credentials, aiming to uncover their attitudes, motivations, and perceived benefits and challenges associated with pursuing these credentials. The survey questionnaire was designed to explore educators' attitudes, motivations, perceived benefits, and challenges related to Micro-credentialing in the context of their professional development. Findings indicate that educators view micro-credentials positively, recognizing them as valuable tools for personal and professional growth, career advancement, and staying competitive in the field. However, several challenges were also identified, including time constraints, financial barriers, uncertainty about the value of micro-credentials, and difficulty in finding suitable programs. These insights provide valuable implications for educational policymakers, institutions, and professional development providers in designing and implementing effective Micro-credentialing initiatives that address educators' needs and preferences.

articleTitle: Solving Heterogeneous Fixed Fleet Vehicle Routing Problem Using Nearest Neighbor Search and 2-Opt Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper presents a detailed investigation into the application of Nearest Neighbor Search (NNS) and 2-Opt methods for addressing the Heterogeneous Fixed Fleet Vehicle Routing Problem (HFVRP), a significant challenge characterized by the management of a vehicle fleet with diverse capacities and operational constraints. Employing mathematical programming and operations research, the study underscores these disciplines' critical role in enhancing package delivery efficiency in logistics and transportation, directly influencing operational costs and system performance. Through an in-depth examination of NNS and 2-Opt algorithms, the methodology section provides insight into their potential to minimize the total distance traveled, thereby reducing costs and improving service quality. A case study based on randomly generated data to mirror real-world scenarios evaluates these strategies' effectiveness. The findings highlight the superior routing efficiency achieved through both algorithms, with 2-0pt showing particular promise in larger-scale applications. Furthermore, this analysis not only delivers a comprehensive assessment of these techniques but also enriches the discourse surrounding vehicle routing challenges, proposing directions for future inquiries into dynamic problem resolution and the optimization of vehicle capacity.

articleTitle: Development and Performance Analysis of Smart Microgreen Cultivation System Using the Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This study looks at the variables that influence microgreens from traditional culture in closed systems in populated regions in terms of germination and growth. The study's findings guided the creation, advancement, and evaluation of an intelligent micro green crop growing system utilizing Internet of Things technology. Light-emitting diodes provide the light that is used. Band of frequencies: 430–660 nm from 06:01 am to 06:01 pm. This method allows vegetables to grow faster, have plump stems and weigh more than normal seeding. methods for controlling soil moisture, water temperature, and relative humidity as well as quality. When the outside temperature drops below thirty degrees Celsius, the designed system can regulate it. Maintain a reasonable level of soil moisture, a range of 60-90% relative humidity, and a water temperature as low as 28 degrees Celsius. From the experiment using a comparison method with conventional farming to cultivate sunflower, water spinach, and spinach. The results indicate that vegetables grown using a factor control system produced more than conventionally cultivated ones, with an average tray length of roughly 3.9 centimeters longer. On the tray, the vegetables grown by the system grow roughly in the same way, and harvesting time can be reduced. 2–3 days.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Data Management Tool Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper proposes a methodology for selecting data management tools. It emphasizes a three-pronged approach: evaluating functionalities against standards, ensuring security compliance, and incorporating third-party assessments. Additionally, it advocates for considering the tool's past performance in real-world deployments. This comprehensive approach aims to empower organizations to make informed decisions in selecting tools that align with their needs and industry trends.

articleTitle: UWB Tracking for Forklift in Near-Automate Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Outdated systems and limited visibility are prevalent issues in 90% of Thai warehouses. The high costs of full automation often pose a challenge to modernization. This research introduces a highly cost-effective solution: a realtime UWB tracking system that tracks forklifts, not individual pallets. This approach significantly reduces picking times and minimizes inventory errors, leading to near-automated efficiency at a fraction of the cost. Our in-house Warehouse Management Software, UNAI, seamlessly integrates with the system for realtime inventory tracking and product updates. A path-based reference method ensures superior product location accuracy. Data privacy is a top priority, with a dedicated server eliminating the need for expensive cloud services. This solution's benefits are significant and manifold, including improved operational efficiency, reduced costs, and enhanced inventory management.

articleTitle: Maximising Solar Irradiation of Semi-transparent Solar Panels in a Multi-loop Aquaponics System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The global population is expected to reach 9.7 billion by 2050, leading to a rise in food demand from 59% to 98%. This emphasises the urgent need to ensure worldwide food security. To optimise the advantages of urban farming, there is a growing focus on exploring and implementing innovative technologies. However, integrating technology into urban farming poses challenges related to increased energy consumption. Agrivoltaics, a practice combining crop agriculture and photovoltaics electricity generation on the same land, has demonstrated enhancements in crop biomass production and energy production. This paper employs a novel modelling and simulation approach to assess the impact of various configurations (direction, height, and tilt angles) of semi-transparent agrivoltaics panels on the solar irradiation of panels and crops. Considering results and advice from local authorities, the panel configuration in a commercial-sized multi-loop aquaponics system at Metro Farm in Downtown East, Singapore, was optimised. The system experienced a 138.36% increase in solar irradiation when panels were placed in the north-facing direction at a height of 3.5 m with a tilt angle of 10° compared to a system without panels. The quantified solar irradiation of the semi-transparent agrivoltaics panels in kilo-watt hours per meter squared was extrapolated to evaluate the overall earnings for the entire urban farm.

articleTitle: Developing a Comprehensive Virtual Learning Management Framework: Key Factors and Strategies for Success
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research addresses the pressing need for effective virtual learning management frameworks (VLMFs) in tra-ditional educational settings. The study explores the key factors influencing virtual learning success and develops a comprehensive VLMF. The framework integrates technology and management as fundamental drivers of success, emphasizing their interplay in creating a conducive virtual learning environment. The research objectives are summarizing key success factors, exploring the VLMF, and developing a conceptual framework integrating technology and management. The study's significance lies in its contribution to the understanding and implementing virtual learning, highlighting the transformative potential of integrating technology and management principles. The findings provide valuable insights into the interconnected factors crucial for virtual learning success, underscoring the importance of a well-coordinated approach in navigating the complexities of virtual education. The study's results have implications for teaching and learning, emphasizing the need for a structured approach to enhance learning outcomes in virtual education.

articleTitle: Utilizing Social Media for Travel Among Elderly People in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Social media appears to be essential for connecting people across all levels and aspects of life. This also includes the elderly people. One aspect of the social media implication is tourism. Therefore, the use of social media among elderly people seems to be increasingly necessary and further exploration. This research aimed to 1) study the social media behavior of senior travelers in Thailand; 2) examine the benefits of social media for senior tourism in Thailand; and 3) analyze the relationships between the characteristics of elderly people and their social media use for tourism purposes. The study utilized a quantitative survey methodology with a sample group of 250 people which aged 60 years and older. Descriptive statistics and inferential analyses were implemented to analyze the results. The findings revealed that most of the sample group exhibited typical tourism behaviors frequently using social media in the context of tourism. Furthermore, elderly people use social media in different stages of travel which are before, during and after the trip. The different activities on social media were aligned in different stages also. The study identified barriers to social media usage statistically. The findings show that age, marital status, and income affected the benefits of social media use. The results can be implemented in terms of personalized social media platform for travel content and appropriate to elderly people.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing the Acceptance of Collaboration Platform for Fleet Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Maintenance management plays a crucial role in the cost dimension of transportation company. Repair and maintenance expenses constitute a significant portion of overall manageable costs and directly impact the revenue generation of these businesses. Effective maintenance manage management is therefore essential for transportation companies to ensure the constant readiness of their vehicles for transportation tasks. This research aimed to study the factors that influence the acceptance of collaborative fleet maintenance platform by conducting a comprehensive in-depth interview with 3 groups 1. Transportation company with in-house fleet maintenance units and nationwide transport services 2. Transportation company without in-house fleet maintenance units and nationwide transport services and 3. Truck repair and maintenance service providers which 20 business per groups. Data was collected through semi-structured interviews. The interviews were transcribed verbatim. Data analysis employed thematic analysis, a qualitative data analysis method that identifies patterns and themes within the collected data. The research results demonstrated the factors that influence the acceptance of collaboration platforms for fleet maintenance are price format, data and information, ease of use and perceived usefulness.

articleTitle: Reimagining Digital Health: Innovations in Virtual Health Service Design
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research studies the critical role of virtual health in addressing contemporary healthcare needs, especially amid the COVID-19 pandemic, and the ongoing efforts to enhance healthcare access and delivery. Utilizing the Enterprise Architecture Framework, the study evaluates telemedicine and virtual health services, highlighting their effectiveness. Expert consensus reveals very high satisfaction across key metrics, including overall acceptability, competitiveness enhancement, effectiveness for one-stop services and telemedicine, universal compatibility, accessibility, and compliance with standards and policies. The findings underscore the numerous benefits of virtual care, such as reducing physical barriers, minimizing restrictions related to time, travel, and costs, and enhancing competitiveness within the medical industry. Implementing the recommended strategies can further improve accessibility, efficiency, and quality of care. Moreover, the integration of advanced technologies like artificial intelligence, remote monitoring, and robust data platforms has significantly boosted personalized medicine, patient-centered care, health literacy, and education, ensuring the population is well-prepared for the digital health era. This research confirms that virtual health services are not only a viable solution for current healthcare challenges but also a transformative approach for the future of healthcare delivery.

articleTitle: Stakeholder Perspective on the Architecture of the Electronic Based Government System (SPBE) in Regional Hospitals
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Adopting an Electronic Based Government System (SPBE) is crucial for all government agencies, including healthcare facilities that provide services to the public. Further details on plans for digital health transformation and the creation of an electronic-based government system in the health sector are provided in the Decree of the Minister of Health of the Republic of Indonesia, number <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{HK}.\mathrm{O}1.07/\text{MENKES}/1559/2022$</tex>. Before SPBE is implemented at XYZ Hospital Regional, it is crucial to evaluate the current state of affairs and identify any necessary changes. This study will analyze and identify stakeholder perspectives of the various components of the Electronic Based Government System (SPBE) architecture in order to compare them with the maturity level of SPBE governance at XYZ Hospital. The study sample comprised 85 participants who represented several stakeholder perspectives, such as hospital administration, management, and medical and non-medical workers. We anticipate that by comprehending the viewpoints of the stakeholders and the existing state of IT governance, we will be able to get a fundamental grasp of how to modify IT governance to meet the demands of XYZ Hospital. The evaluation's findings demonstrate how inadequate the current Electronic-Based Government System is. According to stakeholder perception scores regarding the architectural components of the Electronic Based Government System (SPBE), which yield an average score of 2,1, the assessment results demonstrate that the current Electronic-Based Government System is not ideal. The achievement index is at a sufficient level with this score. Stakeholder perspective results indicate that infrastructure architecture is the most critical component that needs to be addressed out of all the other factors.

articleTitle: Analyzing Social Media Marketing Initiatives of Educational Institution Towards the Adoption of Customer-Focused Marketing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Seeing through and understanding the client's perception with the aim of developing customer-based marketing strategies for an educational institution is the main purpose of this research analysis. Thus, it focuses on analyzing an educational establishment as they transition from traditional to digital platform. The researcher took a glimpse at the school's marketing initiatives and decided to focus on investigating the social media activities as basis for insights, marketing strategies, and streamline the management of their digital services. Moreover, the study delved into analyzing the lived experiences of clients in the context of phenomenological approach. Furthermore, the study is qualitative in nature which employed thematic analysis to provide meaningful sense making of data. Results revealed that most of the participants are interested in the presence of the educational institution in digital platform and perceived the school as an institution that offers quality education which is also aligned with the school brand they portray. However, findings exposed that poor management of information dissemination, unresponsive to inquiries and lack of feedback in school's digital platform are critical issues that can impact the institution's reputation, client's satisfaction, and overall effectiveness. Thus, this study recommends the adoption of Brand Resonance Pyramid and Segmenting, Targeting, and Positioning (STP) as basis in developing their marketing strategy.

articleTitle: An Active Switching for Downtime Mitigation System (ASDMS) for KU-Band Satellite Service (An IoT Implementation)
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper describes the design of an Active Switching for Downtime Mitigation System (ASDMS) for Ku band which has been deployed at Si Racha and Nonthaburi, satellite earth stations located in Chonburi and Nonthaburi provinces, Thailand. The system consists of KU-Band satellite transmitters (on both stations) with SNMP protocol enabled, a host computer running Node-Red software and a Private Link Circuit (PLC) connection linking between two stations. With both transmitters linking via PLC using a custom Node-Red flow. The system is able to detect a transmitting signal degradation due to rain, other precipitation and clouds attenuation and automatically switch an uplink station from the main to backup stations at a distance of over a hundred kilometers away in real-time. Since the deployment of the ASDMS, a significant reduction of service downtime on both stations and higher customer satisfaction are achieved.

articleTitle: Modernization Through ICT for Efficiency & Transparency: Equipment Revolving Fund
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This paper examines the Equipment Revolving Fund in Thailand, a critical entity for maintaining and enhancing the nation's transportation infrastructure. While this organization undeniably ensures the quality of Thailand's transportation network, its effectiveness is hampered by manual processes and outdated information systems. These limitations can lead to operational inefficiencies, reduced transparency, and potential delays in crucial infrastructure projects. This study proposes a modernization initiative that leverages Information and Communication Technologies to improve the organization's operational efficiency significantly. We identify key challenges hindering the organization's effectiveness, including slow procurement procedures, limited data accessibility, and potential inefficiencies in construction material and equipment management. The paper proposes specific solutions to address these challenges including implementing cloud-based Enterprise Resource Planning. The successful implementation of these solutions is expected to expedite procurement processes, improve resource allocation for infrastructure projects, and enhance accountability within the Department of Highways. The paper acknowledges potential challenges associated with the modernization initiative, such as user adoption, data security, and system maintenance. However, it proposes thorough and effective mitigation strategies to ensure a successful implementation. The proposed solutions, while tailored to this organization, offer valuable insights for modernizing revolving fund management practices in other government agencies, particularly those collaborating with external entities like the Consolidated Financial Statement Program, Non-Budgetary Management System, Revolving Fund Evaluation System, and KrungThai Bank Corporate Online.

articleTitle: Employees' Perceptions on Service Robot Acceptance in Chengdu Hotel Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: In a global situation, the hotel industry faces the challenges of digital transformation, over-supply, diversified consumer demand and rising labour costs. The hotel industry must take advantage of technological changes to meet market demands and maintain a competitive advantage. The hotel industry has adopted service robots to provide personalized services, improve efficiency and reduce costs. With the development of artificial intelligence and the widespread application of robots, the hotel industry is increasingly using service robots to change hotel service. Most studies focus on consumer perceptions and less on employees. Employees are evolving as technology changes. As the internal customers of the organization, employees are crucial to the sustainable development of the organization. This study explores employees' perceptions of service robot acceptance in the Chengdu hotel industry. A mixed method was used in this study. The results of this study show that perceived ease of use, facilitating conditions and attitude towards service robots have the strongest correlation with employee behaviour intentions. Therefore, it has the most significant impact on employees' behaviour in accepting and using service robots.

articleTitle: Enhancing Financial Market Predictions in Taiwan: A Hybrid Approach of Traditional Analysis and Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: This research delves into the comparative effectiveness of traditional panel data analysis versus machine learning (ML) algorithms in forecasting stock returns, specifically within the context of the Taiwanese stock market. It aims to assess these methodologies against the backdrop of the semi-strong form of the Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) [1]. Employing a dataset spanning from 2015 to 2023, which encapsulates financial metrics from 54 prominent companies listed on the FTSE TWSE Taiwan 50 Index and TSEC Taiwan Mid-Cap 100 Index, the study juxtaposes traditional econometric methods with advanced ML techniques such as Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests (RF), and Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks [2], [3], [4]. The analysis incorporates a dynamic panel data regression model to scrutinize various financial ratios, while ML algorithms are evaluated for their precision in handling complex data structures and predicting market trends. The outcome of the study reveals that traditional panel data analysis not only holds its ground but also occasionally outperforms ML algorithms in ensuring stability and consistency in return predictions across both equally weighted and value-weighted portfolios. These findings highlight the enduring relevance of conventional financial analysis methods and suggest a symbiotic integration of traditional and modern approaches to enhance the robustness and accuracy of financial market predictions. The study advances the discourse on the utility of integrating computational technologies within traditional financial frameworks, providing insights that could influence future investment strategies and market analysis methodologies.

articleTitle: Abstract Book
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)

articleTitle: Enhancing Operational Efficiency in Community Pharmacies through Robotic Process Automation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: The Robotic Process Automation (RPA) is revolutionizing pharmacy industry by enhancing efficiency, accuracy, and patient care. This technology automates repetitive and time-consuming tasks, allowing pharmacists to focus more on clinical services and patient interactions. However, the process of implementing RPA and the tasks selection in community pharmacy seems to be vague. Therefore, the study to explore the potential of RPA in enhancing the efficiency of community pharmacy services is needed. This study uses a mixed-methods approach, the research combined qualitative and quantitative data collection and analysis. Data were gathered from semi-structured interviews and direct observations across 12 to identify key workflows, challenges, and opportunities for RPA implementation. The study proposed four prototype activities for RPA development and testing, focusing on price comparison from multiple suppliers, competitor price checking for healthcare supplements, inventory updates in Point of Sale (POS) systems, and social media content generation. Among these, the price comparison process was selected for detailed testing due to its high relevance and potential impact on operational efficiency. Results from the prototype testing indicated a significant efficiency improvement, with the automated process reducing the average time for price comparison from 7 minutes to 4 minutes per 30 items, translating to an efficiency gain of approximately 42.86%. While the initial setup posed technical challenges and required human oversight, the study demonstrated that RPA could substantially reduce manual effort and errors in pharmacy operations.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Computerized Adaptive Testing with Rasch Analysis for Identifying VAK Learning Styles
publicationTitle: 2024 5th Technology Innovation Management and Engineering Science International Conference (TIMES-iCON)
abstract: Understanding learner variability in learning styles is critical for optimizing personalized learning benefits. Learning style, a concept within educational psychology, has been explored through various theoretical frameworks, including VAK (Visual, Auditory, and Kinesthetic) learning modalities. This study utilized a multidisciplinary approach to develop and test a web-based Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT) system, aiming to overcome the limitations of conventional questionnaire-based assessments, such as potential disinterest and unreliable outcomes, in determining VAK learning styles. The study approach involved the recruitment of computer science students from Mae Fah Luang University. It also included developing a web-based CAT system using Django.
